origin.comment: Fixed world origin: BNG point that maps to UE (0,0). Near Ashton town centre. Never change after M1 content exists.

landscape.comment: z_scale 128 with location_z 300 m gives exactly 1 cm per height unit and a -27.68 m .. +627.67 m range (ODN).

ashton_centre.comment: Vertical slice: about 2 x 2 km around Ashton-under-Lyne town centre.

tameside_full.comment: Whole borough plus margin, 9 x 9 tiles of 2016 m.
